techStack: Vitest 3.2.4 + Testing Library React 16.3.2 + jsdom — run via `pnpm test --run`; build via `pnpm build` (tsc -b then vite)
TypeScript strict: noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters — the `_onChange` rename in FilterPanel/SortSelect must be corrected to `onChange` or the build will fail
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use `import type`
Coverage scoped only to src/utils/productFilters.ts; tests live under tests/ and must not be modified
Test setup (tests/setup.ts) mocks global fetch and seeds 15 product fixtures used by all tests
features: WORKING: App layout, loading/error states, pagination (Prev/Next), useProductFilters hook (fetches products, tracks page/totalPages), ProductList/ProductCard rendering, categories derivation, visibleProducts useMemo
STUBBED: filterProducts() — all 4 operations (search, category, inStockOnly, sort) are TODO no-ops that return the unfiltered array
STUBBED: FilterPanel — search input, category select, inStockOnly checkbox onChange handlers are empty lambdas; 'Clear filters' onClick is empty; prop is destructured as `_onChange` (unused)
STUBBED: SortSelect — select onChange is empty lambda; prop is destructured as `_onChange` (unused)
PARTIAL: App.tsx SortSelect handler calls setFilters but omits setPage(1); FilterPanel receives raw setFilters (no page reset)
FilterState type: { search: string, category: string, inStockOnly: boolean, sortBy: 'default' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating-desc' }
Product flow: useProductFilters fetches → App derives categories + memoizes visibleProducts via filterProducts() → FilterPanel/SortSelect/ProductList receive slices of that state
architecture: src/utils/productFilters.ts — all filter/sort logic; filterProducts(products, filters) is the single export
src/components/FilterPanel.tsx — controlled component; receives FilterState + onChange(FilterState) prop
src/components/SortSelect.tsx — controlled component; receives sortBy + onChange(sortBy) prop
src/App.tsx — orchestrator: holds filter/page state, computes visibleProducts in useMemo, passes handlers down
src/hooks/useProductFilters.ts — manages API fetch + pagination state; App consumes its return value
src/types/product.ts — shared Product, PaginatedResponse types; FilterState defined in productFilters.ts
No new files needed — all 4 changes are in-place edits to existing files
edgeCases: Search: trim input before matching; case-insensitive (`toLowerCase` or regex /i); empty/whitespace-only term matches all 15 products
Category 'All': must return all products — treat as no-filter sentinel, not an actual category value
inStockOnly false: no filtering — return all products regardless of inStock field
sortBy 'default': return products in original order — no sort applied
Sort mutation: sort must operate on a copy (`[...products].sort(...)`) — tests render App multiple times from the same fixture and assert original order is preserved
Clear filters resets all 4 fields: { search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false, sortBy: 'default' } — sortBy must be included
Filter/sort change on page > 1 must call setPage(1) — both FilterPanel and SortSelect onChange wrappers in App.tsx must reset page
TypeScript will reject unused `_onChange` parameter names — rename to `onChange` to satisfy noUnusedParameters and make the prop callable

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — filterProducts must filter by search (case-insensitive, trimmed), category (exact match, 'All' = no filter), inStockOnly, and sort (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc, default = original order) without mutating the input array
